decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The window in the extension to the eastern elevation, and the lower half of the sash windows on eastern elevation to the kitchen will be fixed shut and will only be glazed in obscure glass and will only be repaired or replaced in obscure glass

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The application for the proposed single storey rear extension to ground floor flat and erection of rear roof extension incorporating 2 roof lights to front elevation of 1st floor flat, as shown on drawings P.01, 02 and 07, Received 13th February 2006, and P. 03B, 04A, 05B and 06B, Received 15th March 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the single storey rear extension and roof extension by reason of its size, materials and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 28 Oxford Gardens, Chiswick. The extensions would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to ground floor flat and erection of rear roof extension incoroparating 2 roof lights to front elevation of 1st floor flat.
